events.name: Red Bull New York at Atlanta United FC

headlines.description: Fafà Picault scored the go-ahead goal in the 82nd minute, Tristan Muyumba scored for the second consecutive game, and Atlanta United rallied to beat the New York Red Bulls 2-1 on Saturday night to snap a seven-game winless streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Atlanta beats Red Bulls to snap 7-game winless skid

headlines.description: Tai Baribo scored a goal for the fifth consecutive game and Sean Johnson had six saves Saturday night for D.C. United in a 1-1 tie with CF Montreal.
headlines.shortLinkText: Baribo scores again as DC United tie with Montreal

events.name: FC Cincinnati at Orlando City SC

headlines.description: Tyrese Spicer scored early in the second half to help Orlando City earn a 1-1 draw with FC Cincinnati on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Spicer gives Orlando City tie with Cincinnati

events.name: New England Revolution at Toronto FC

headlines.description: Niklas Dorsch scored his first career goal in MLS, Luka Gavran had five saves, and Toronto FC beat the New England Revolution 2-1 on Saturday night to snap a 12-game winless streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Toronto beats Revolution for 1st win since April 4

events.name: LA Galaxy at Houston Dynamo FC

headlines.description: Guilherme Santos scored on a first-half penalty kick and Jonathan Bond posted his fourth clean sheet in a row to help the Houston Dynamo beat the Los Angeles Galaxy 1-0 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dynamo beats Galaxy for fourth straight shutout

events.name: Inter Miami CF at Nashville SC

headlines.description: Hany Mukhtar scored a pair of second-half goals and Nashville SC beat Lionel Messi and Inter Miami 4-1 on Saturday night in a match featuring the top two teams in the Eastern Conference to remain atop the MLS standings.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mukhtar brace helps 1st-placed Nashville rout Miami
